title: Perfectness detected on open neighbourhoods
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme, $K\in D(\mathcal O_S)$ [def-pc-derived-category]. Suppose that for every $x\in S$ there is an open neighbourhood $U$ such that $L\iota_U^*K$ [def-pc-derived-pullback] is perfect on the open subscheme $U$ [def-pc-perfect-complex]. Then $K$ is perfect on $S$.

source.place: Tag 08CM, definition-perfect; Tag 0A1H, lemma-base-change-tensor-perfect, locality sentence

proof.text: For x choose U from the hypothesis and a strictly perfect representative near the corresponding point of U. Regard its open neighbourhood V as an open of S contained in U.

Open tensor pullback is exact, so uniqueness of left derived functors identifies derivedPullback U.ι with exact localized restriction followed by Modules.overEquiv U. Apply the proved local_perfect_of_openRestriction_iso to this comparison and the perfect object on U. It transports a strictly perfect model to an ambient open containing x, providing exactly the witness in IsPerfect S K.

theorem perfect_of_open_pullbacks
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (U : Z.Opens), HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    {S : Scheme.{u}} (K : schemeDerivedCategory S)
    (h : ∀ x : S, ∃ U : S.Opens, x ∈ U ∧
      Scheme.IsPerfect U.toScheme ((derivedPullback U.ι).obj K)) :
    Scheme.IsPerfect S K
